scope: Held-out direct comparison of action-selection semantics under a true independent inference and control clock
research_question: Does observation-age-aligned suffix selection change closed-loop task progress relative to starting each completed action chunk at its head when checkpoint, deadline, clock, mailbox, hold rule, and keyed sampling are fixed?

modes.definition: At each control tick execute chunk index ceil(observation_age/control_period); hold if the deadline is exceeded or no fresh suffix remains.
After a response arrives execute chunk indices 0, 1, 2, ... relative to response completion; retain the same observation-age deadline and fail-closed hold rule.

required_before_scored_matrix: both artifacts pass the independent validator
query-0 policy sampling key and noise SHA-256 values match

pairing_gate.unit: task_id plus episode_index within a joint seed
pairing_gate.failure_disposition: Exclude the affected seed pair from method-effect claims; preserve and document the rejected artifacts.

analysis_plan.success_test: Exact two-sided McNemar test over registered paired episodes, reported with discordant counts.
analysis_plan.cluster_reporting: Report each task and seed separately; task-by-seed blocks, not 120 episodes as iid deployment draws, define robustness summaries.
analysis_plan.process_metrics: Report paired differences descriptively with task-by-seed block intervals.
analysis_plan.pooling: Do not combine this held-out matrix with earlier episodes 0:3 to increase the paired sample size.
analysis_plan.negative_result_policy: Retain and report a null or reversed result; do not add modes, deadlines, or seeds after inspection.

stop_conditions: provider failure, missing inference/simulation overlap, worker not stopped, or validator invalid
checkpoint attestation, OpenPI commit, runtime commit, or source hashes differ between paired modes
less than 90 minutes of server lease remains before starting another scored cell
do not stop a 40-rollout cell based on intermediate task success
claim_boundaries: one attested pi0.5 checkpoint and one LIBERO suite, not cross-model generality
exploratory held-out simulation evidence, not an official LIBERO leaderboard score
not hardware safety or real-robot deployment evidence
query-0 pairing does not imply later observations remain identical after the modes diverge
